description: This file defines a class SugarWidgetSubPanelEditSecurityGroupUserButton that extends SugarWidgetField, providing methods to generate display content for a security group user button in a subpanel within SugarCRM. It includes rendering logic for header cells and detail list items, incorporating links and icons for editing security group user relationships.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelEditSecurityGroupUserButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a button in a subpanel to edit security group user relationships.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns a non-breaking space to render as header cell content.

methods.name: displayDetail
methods.description: Returns the output of displayList method for detail view rendering.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates an HTML link with an icon to edit security group user relationships, or returns an empty string if not in list view.
